uplink.description: Sub-zero temperature -8.25 C at 1002.5 hPa, battery 3.3 V (two's-complement temperature word)
uplink._note: Regression vector for the fixed upstream sign bug: bytes[7..10]=0xFFFFFCC7 is -825 hundredths = -8.25 C under two's complement, but 4294966471/100 = 42949664.71 C read unsigned as upstream does — a value that clears the air.temperature bound (min -273.15) and so would be stored rather than rejected. Pressure raw 100250000/100000 = 1002.5 hPa. Synthetic: the vendor supplies no sub-zero example, so the encoding is inferred from the 16-bit two's complement every sibling in this family uses.
